name: Peace Offerings
overview: Peace offerings in Scripture are presented as a vital aspect of worship, symbolizing fellowship and communion with God. The passages in Exodus illustrate that these offerings, including sacrifices of sheep and oxen, were to be made on altars established by God’s command and were considered a pleasing aroma to the Lord. The detailed instructions given for consecration rituals, such as the waving and burning of portions of the ram along with unleavened bread, emphasize the sacredness and deliberate nature of these offerings as acts of dedication and thanksgiving.
